title: The Deck Saigon Sunset Cocktail Cruise
description: Escape the city's frenzy with an elegant sunset cruise along the Saigon River, finishing with craft cocktails at the city's most prestigious riverside.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * The Deck Saigon Sunset Cocktail Cruise offers a 3-hour, low-physical-demand luxury experience, combining a private speedboat transfer from a downtown pier to The Deck's private dock in Thao Dien for sunset cocktails. This year-round offering requires advance booking and includes luxury SUV transfers.
> * AGS clients receive priority reservations and skip-the-line access for this sophisticated riverside lounge experience, ensuring a seamless, traffic-free transition to an evening of award-winning cocktails. The dress code is smart casual, with some venues requiring closed-toe shoes.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Escape the city's frenzy with an elegant sunset cruise along the Saigon River, finishing with craft cocktails at the city's most prestigious riverside lounge.

## The Operator & Origin Story
The Deck redefined riverside luxury in Ho Chi Minh City. By combining their private speedboat fleet with premium dining in Thao Dien, they provide a seamless, traffic-free transition.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
A luxury speedboat picks you up from the downtown pier. Disembark directly at The Deck's private dock. You are seated at a reserved riverside lounge table exactly as the sun dips below the horizon for an evening of award-winning cocktails.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Sophisticated, Relaxed, Scenic |
| **Duration** | 3 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Low |
| **Best Paired With** | A restful evening away from the city center. |

## Bypassing Ho Chi Minh City Rush-Hour Traffic via Private Speedboat After Golf
Anyone who has finished a morning round at [Vietnam Golf & Country Club (VGCC)](/courses/vietnam/vgcc/), [Tan Son Nhat Golf Course](/courses/vietnam/tan-son-nhat/), [Twin Doves Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/twin-doves/), or [Long Thanh Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/long-thanh/) knows that crossing Ho Chi Minh City by road between 4:30 PM and 6:30 PM toward the leafy riverside enclave of Thao Dien (District 2) can take 45 minutes of bumper-to-bumper congestion. **The Deck Saigon Sunset Cocktail Cruise** transforms that commute into the most glamorous golden-hour transition on our [Southern Vietnam Links](/tours/southern-vietnam-links/) itinerary: a 5-minute transfer from [Park Hyatt Saigon](/accommodations/vietnam/park-hyatt-saigon/), [The Reverie Saigon](/accommodations/vietnam/the-reverie-saigon/), or [Caravelle Saigon](/accommodations/vietnam/the-caravelle/) brings your group to Bach Dang Pier in District 1, where you step aboard a privately chartered wooden-deck speedboat.

## Saigon River Golden Hour & Reserved Timber Deck Dining
* **45-Minute Private River Charter With Champagne:** Cruise past the towering Landmark 81 skyscraper and historic port cranes as the equatorial sun drops behind the Saigon skyline, enjoying chilled champagne or craft G&Ts served onboard before docking directly at The Deck’s private floating jetty in Thao Dien.
* **Front-Row Waterfront Lounge & Pan-Asian Dinner:** Step off the boat directly onto The Deck’s candlelit timber boardwalk—where Asia Golf Specialists pre-reserves a river-edge cocktail lounge table and optional dining seating for Wagyu tataki, Phu Quoc pepper-crusted tuna, and chilled oyster platters.
* **Flexible Return by Speedboat or Standby SUV:** After dinner around 9:00 PM, when road traffic has cleared, your luxury private touring vehicle transfers your group back to District 1 in 15 minutes—either straight to your hotel or to the 26th floor of AB Tower for late-night sets at [Chill Skybar](/destinations/vietnam/vietnam-nightlife-chill-skybar-saigon/).

## Ideal Sequencing on a Southern Vietnam Golf & Coastal Links Tour
For travelers on our [Southern Vietnam Links](/tours/southern-vietnam-links/) itinerary—which pairs city rounds at [Tan Son Nhat Golf Course](/courses/vietnam/tan-son-nhat/), [Vietnam Golf & Country Club (VGCC)](/courses/vietnam/vgcc/), and [Twin Doves Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/twin-doves/) with a coastal links finale at Greg Norman’s [The Bluffs Grand Ho Tram](/courses/vietnam/the-bluffs-ho-tram/)—this 5:00 PM private speedboat cruise from Bach Dang Pier near [Park Hyatt Saigon](/accommodations/vietnam/park-hyatt-saigon/), [The Reverie Saigon](/accommodations/vietnam/the-reverie-saigon/), and [Caravelle Saigon](/accommodations/vietnam/the-caravelle/) is the most refined evening experience in Ho Chi Minh City.

faqs.q: Where does The Deck Saigon Sunset Cocktail Cruise depart in Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Your private speedboat departs from Bach Dang Pier on Ton Duc Thang Street in District 1—less than 5 minutes from The Reverie Saigon, Park Hyatt Saigon, and Caravelle Saigon—and docks directly at The Deck's private riverside pier in Thao Dien.

faqs.q: How does the sunset river cruise fit into a Saigon golf day at Tan Son Nhat or VGCC?
faqs.a: After an early 7:30 AM round at Tan Son Nhat Golf Course or Vietnam Golf & Country Club (VGCC), you return to your District 1 hotel by 1:30 PM to rest before boarding the 4:45 PM sunset speedboat charter.

faqs.q: Can we stay for dinner at The Deck Saigon after the sunset cocktail cruise?
faqs.a: Yes. Asia Golf Specialists automatically links your sunset speedboat arrival with a reserved riverfront dining table at The Deck Saigon, followed by a private luxury SUV transfer back to District 1 after dinner.
